title: Nutty Crisp Japanese Almond Dorayaki
description: A macrobiotic-friendly Japanese dessert featuring ground almonds and a crispy exterior, perfect for a post-workout snack. This earthy treat is made with wholesome ingredients and a traditional dorayaki form.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or dorayaki pan over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together ground almonds, flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and water.
Add the egg mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Add sesame oil and stir until the batter is smooth.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the preheated skillet or dorayaki pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown and crispy.
Loosen the dorayaki with a spatula and flip it over.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Fill the dorayaki with red bean paste and serve immediately.
